dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: Did you hear the rumors about the water and the soil?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Rumors?

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: Shhh! Don't let anyone else hear! I'm only telling you, alright!?

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: There've been more and more Xuanwen Beasts skulking in the mountains lately. A fiend must be behind all this, or something!

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: If you ask me, the quality of the tea's gone down because these monsters contaminated the water and the soil.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Rumors?

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: Shhh! Don't let anyone else hear! I'm only telling you, alright!?

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: A kind Carp Adeptus awakened recently, saw the damage in Chenyu Vale, and stopped the Xuanwen Beasts from wreaking more havoc.

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: If that rumor's true, the quality of tea will return to normal soon, easy!

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: Maybe it'll even be better than before!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm more interested in that machine than rumors...

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: A practical one, aren't you? No interest in rumors, all work, work, work... Gah, you're making me feel bad.

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: Anyway, this is the machine we use to bake the tea leaves. Some of the tea is placed in here after stirring to get rid of the moisture.

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: The flames under the machine might be powerful, but the temperature inside isn't too high, so the process takes a good while.

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: I don't need to watch the machine every second, so all in all, this job's not too tiring.

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: But Ol' Senior can't be distracted at all. I'm afraid I can't do his job yet...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: Take care, and see you next time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, that's reaching a bit too far...

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: You have no idea just how complicated it is.

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: I think we'll need a thaumaturge to exorcise the fiends... or find some really powerful people to settle this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If you really twist it, it kinda makes sense...

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: Moving, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: But baking is something I have to do every day, so my days are more or less the same.

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: If only the Carp Adeptus could make tea easier to process... Or improve my techniques...

dialogues.speaker: Ding Jr.
dialogues.text: Have you heard the rumors about the Carp Adeptus?
